evidence.moatW: セグメント別売上(FY2025・10-K 2025-06-30期): Employer Services 67.5%(13,883.1百万$・税引前利益5,008.5) / PEO Services 32.5%(6,690.4百万$・税引前利益950.5)、合計20,560.9百万$(社内消去-12.6)。ただしPEO Servicesの売上には zero-margin benefits pass-through costs 4,289.0百万$が総額計上されており、これを除いた実質PEO売上は2,401.4百万$=調整後総額16,271.9百万$の14.8%で≥15%に届かない。加えてPEO(TotalSource)はEmployer Servicesの給与計算基盤の上に構築された共同雇用サービスであり、上流が折れれば同時に折れる=独立した堀とは言えない。最大事業のEmployer Servicesは67.5%で『単一製品<70%』を満たし、顧客集中も同10-K『We provide services to more than 1.1 million clients. In fiscal 2025, no single client or group of affiliated clients accounted for revenues in excess of 2% of our annual consolidated revenues』で最大顧客<10%。→ 単一事業(給与計算・HCMアウトソーシング)だが用途・顧客・地域が分散した1本の堀 → moatW=70。※報告売上ベースではPEO 32.5%(セグメント税引前利益ベースでも15.9%)で刻み85の見方も成り立つが、パススルー除きで15%を割ることと基盤共有を重く見て保守側の70を採った。出典: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/8670/000000867025000037/adp-20250630.htm (R103・Item1 CLIENTS AND CLIENT CONTRACTS)
evidence.dom: 支配シェア: 会社原本(10-K FY2025)はシェア%を開示せず『more than 1.1 million clients』『no single client or group of affiliated clients accounted for revenues in excess of 2% of our annual consolidated revenues』のみ。規模の第三者/自社リサーチ値: ADP Research『ADP provides payroll services for more than 26 million U.S. workers at more than 500,000 employers, or 1 in 6 workers in the country and 1 in 5 workers in the private sector』=米国全労働者の約16.7%(民間の約20%)。給与計算ソフト市場ベースでは Apps Run The World(2024)でADP約9.9%、enlyftで約14.33%。最も広く採る『1 in 6』でも16.7%、市場シェアベースでは10-14%台で、いずれも40%を大きく下回る。→ 競争<40% → dom=50。※会社原本にシェア開示はなく第三者推計である旨を明記。出典: 10-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/8670/000000867025000037/adp-20250630.htm / https://www.adpresearch.com/research/how-representative-is-adp-employment-data / https://www.appsruntheworld.com/top-10-hcm-software-vendors-in-payroll-market-segment/
evidence.irr: irr=70(高摩擦移行困難)。10-K Item1:『Our business is typically characterized by long-term client relationships that result in recurring revenue. ... Based on our retention levels in fiscal 2025, our client retention is estimated at approximately 13 years in Employer Services, and approximately 6 years in PEO.』移行摩擦の実測＝13年。注記も『The Company has estimated the amortization periods for deferred costs by using its historical client retention rates by business unit ... The expected client relationship period ranges from three to eight years.』と導入コストの資産化期間で裏付け。加えて『ADP Marketplace ... offering access to over 800 partner solutions』および『ADP API Central offers secure APIs and tools and resources for custom integrations』＝顧客HR基盤への配線が乗換コスト化。85/100にしない理由:『The industries in which we operate are highly competitive. We know of no reliable statistics by which we can determine the number of our competitors』＝代替供給者は多数存在し認証ロック/唯一供給ではない。出典 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/8670/000000867025000037/adp-20250630.htm
evidence.rep: rep=80(極困難)。10-K Item1:『In 1949, our founders established ADP ... In the more than 75 years since』『serving over 1.1 million clients and paying over 42 million workers in over 140 countries and territories』『The global scale and scope of our client base provide us the industry's largest and deepest HCM dataset with over 1.1 million clients spanning over 140 countries and territories and 42 million workers globally.』賃金・税の徴収送金は『we offer wage and tax collection and/or remittance services in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, India, China, Hong Kong, Macau, Malaysia, and Taiwan』と多法域のコンプライアンス実装を要する。PEOは『ADP TotalSource is the largest PEO certified by the Internal Revenue Service as meeting the requirements to operate as a Certified Professional Employer Organization』かつESAC認定。76年＋140カ国の規制対応網の再構築は極困難。100にしない理由:同10-Kが『highly competitive』とし同規模の代替提供者(ERP/クラウドHCM/金融機関)の存在を明記。出典 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/8670/000000867025000037/adp-20250630.htm
evidence.dur: dur=75(スイッチングコスト型)。堀の源泉は規制免許でも物理資産でもネットワーク効果でもなく、給与・税務・福利の基幹業務が顧客側に埋め込まれることによる乗換障壁。原本の直接証拠は『client retention is estimated at approximately 13 years in Employer Services』および導入原価の資産化(『cost incurred to implement clients on our solutions (e.g., direct labor) that are expected to be recovered are capitalized and amortized on a straight-line basis over the client retention period』)＝導入に実費を要し容易に捨てられない。競争環境は『The industries in which we operate are highly competitive』であり規制型(100)ではない。出典 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/8670/000000867025000037/adp-20250630.htm
